responsibility: Implements GCC-specific convenience operations on top of libcpp’s rich_location. It adds helpers for marking tree expressions as ranges, suggesting identifier replacements, formatting inserted fix-it text with indentation-sensitive line insertion, computing labels for type mismatches, and constructing binary_op_rich_location objects that split a binary operation into operator and operand ranges when location data permits.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for GCC-specific rich_location helpers: it contains the tree-aware range, fix-it formatting, type-mismatch labeling, and binary-operator location logic, whereas gcc-rich-location.h declares the gcc_rich_location and related helper classes/interfaces.
